Schramm, J. (ed.) (2020). Methane Emission Control. Annex 51-1, Advanced Motor Fuels Technology Collaboration Programme, February 2020. DTU Mechanical Engineering (operating agent), with Denmark, Finland, Japan, Korea, Sweden and Switzerland.

BACKGROUND ONLY - no extraction. What it is and why no data: Methane slip from natural-gas and dual-fuel engines (marine, heavy-duty vehicle): slip mechanisms, engine modelling, hydrogen addition, CH4 oxidation catalysts, seven case studies. Engine research, not industrial equipment; no slip rates for stationary industrial engines or costs. What it does have: Methane slip by load case for a medium-speed marine engine (Table CS1.1), catalyst test results, Euro VI CH4 limit 0.5 g/kWh. Possibly relevant to reciprocating-engine_chp methane slip but measured on marine and vehicle engines.
